articles.title: Meta announces $95 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
articles.summary: Meta said Monday it is planning to raise a total of $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure and superintelligence. It plans to balance funding for these investments through a mix of operating cash flow, investment-grade debt, partnerships and equity capital. The decision to raise more money "reflects the eye-watering levels of investment required to keep up in the AI arms race," Ben Wood, senior partner at CCS Insight, told CNBC.

articles.title: Mortgage rates above 7% are the 'new normal'—here's why
articles.summary: When inflation remains elevated, investors generally demand higher yields on long-term bonds to compensate for the declining purchasing power of the money they'll eventually be repaid. Inflation, as measured by the Fed's preferred PCE price index, hasn't been below the central bank's 2% target since February 2021.

articles.title: Neocloud stocks fall as Elon Musk says more than 200 of them face 'guppy-level death'
articles.summary: Shares of major neocloud stocks fell on Monday after Elon Musk said that more than 200 companies in the sector could collapse. Nebius and CoreWeave dropped around 4%, adding pressure to a sector already facing investor concerns about debt-fueled expansion and whether the large AI infrastructure buildout will generate returns.

articles.title: Apollo to buy nearly 10% stake in Abu Dhabi-backed alternative asset manager Mubadala Capital
articles.summary: Investing giant Apollo Global Management is finalizing a deal to buy nearly a 10% stake in Mubadala Capital, the alternative asset manager subsidiary of Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth fund, Mubadala Investment Co., according to people familiar with the matter who spoke on condition of anonymity.

articles.title: Cracking AI trade has Wall Street looking for a hedge. An ex-Citadel quant may have the answer
articles.summary: As CoreWeave shares plummet, taking much of the AI complex with it, investors face a simple question: what's the best way to hedge AI risk? It's a 50-person financial technology startup building a spot marketplace for tradable GPU computing power, a tool that would allow traders to hedge against a decline in AI demand. The platform allows investors to buy and sell GPU clusters, the units that power AI compute.

articles.title: Defense tech investment boom sparks bubble warning as private equity pours in
articles.summary: Private equity firms are pouring billions into defense technology as rising military spending and geopolitical tensions fuel an investment boom. Traditional buyout investors are increasingly backing younger, high-growth firms in the sector, according to PitchBook data, with private equity growth investments in defense reaching $4 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up from $500 million in 2024.

articles.title: Oil slides over 2% as traders weigh Saudi attack risks, demand destruction
articles.summary: crude oil fell over 2% on Monday as investors weighed the threat of further attacks on Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure against concerns that elevated prices could eventually erode demand. Speaking to CNBC, Michael Alfaro, chief investment officer at Gallo Partners, estimated that geopolitical uncertainty had already added roughly $20 a barrel to oil prices.

articles.title: SoftBank reportedly plans $50 billion tech investment in aspiring 'AI nation' Malaysia
articles.summary: The country's prime minister said the planned investments would focus on artificial intelligence, new technologies and data centers, according to the report. The planned investment comes as Malaysia seeks to become an "AI nation" by 2030, with the government launching a national AI action plan earlier this year to strengthen the country's AI capabilities and infrastructure. Microsoft also announced a $2.2 billion investment in cloud and AI infrastructure and other digital initiatives.
